title: Rule test
draftNotice: Uses the current unsaved draft; the test runs the rule layer and structural parsing only, and does not execute tools, call the Reviewer or write approval audit records.
importEmpty: No call record to import yet.
importUnavailable: Audit records are unavailable, so a call record cannot be imported.
needsRetest: The draft or the input changed, so the result below needs another test.
ruleScope: The scope does not include this call
ruleDisabled: The rule is disabled and does not take part in evaluation
noRuleHint: Click "Test" in the rule list to select a rule, then its own result appears here.
pathRule: The whole draft takes the verdict of {id}.
reviewNoMatch: No rule matched, so the call goes to the default review.
reviewIncomplete: The structure is incomplete, so the whole call cannot be confirmed and goes to the default review.
reviewUnresolved: A higher-precedence rule could not be determined, so allow was not applied and the call goes to the default review.
reviewUnresolvedNoAllow: Some rules could not be determined, so the final rule path is unknown and the call goes to the default review.
reviewPartialAllow: The matching allow does not cover the whole call, so it goes to the default review.
reviewHint: Entering review only describes the path and does not predict the model result; "require human approval" does not actually prompt here.
valuesEmpty: No value was selected: an empty result does not match, and it is not the same as "all matched".
reasonMissing: No match: that structure does not exist.
reasonEmptySelection: No match: the JSONPath selected no value.
reasonValueMismatch: No match: the value does not fit the expression.
reasonScope: Not evaluated: the rule scope does not include this call.
reasonResolved: Match: the value fits the expression.
reasonUnresolvedStructure: Undetermined: the relevant structure cannot be resolved.
reasonParseError: Undetermined: the arguments cannot be traversed.
reasonUnsupported: Undetermined: this value has no comparable text form.
shadowedNone: Nothing was overridden by a higher-precedence rule.
noAllow: The whole draft has no matching allow rule.
parseOpaque: An opaque structure exists, so the whole call cannot be claimed as seen.
jsonShape: The arguments must be a JSON object.
invalidRules: Some rules in the draft failed validation, so the whole rule set cannot be tested:
issuesOutdated: The draft changed, so the original error positions no longer match the same condition; run the test again.
